facts.value: Access to the Sun Devil Fitness Complexes on ASU’s four metro Phoenix campuses.
Your commitment to being healthy in college is all up to you.
Plenty of ways to eat right, work out, and see a doctor when ill.
As a first-year student, you’ll live on the campus of your degree program in a residential college community.
Living and learning communities are organized by major, so your roommate and neighbors will also be your classmates.
You’ll have access to tutoring, advising, events, staff members and other academic resources just steps away from your new home.
A GPA or grade point average is the average of letter grades (A = 4, B = 3, C = 2, D = 1, F = 0) earned in school.
ASU uses a 4.00 scale.
The average GPA of incoming students gives a sense of how competitive the college or university is.
The SAT is a standardized test used for college admission in the U.S. The SAT tests math, reading and writing.
Register for the test with College Board.
The ACT is a standardized college readiness and admission test. The ACT tests English, math, reading and science skills.
Register for the ACT online.
As an international student, you'll pay ASU for tuition and fees.
Housing and meals, books and supplies, transportation, and personal expenses will vary depending on your spending choices.
Costs should be budgeted into your college expenses.
Check out ASU's Net Price Calculator for an estimate of costs after financial aid.
